summary: SCRTD staff are mentioned in the Community Participation chapter as having assisted Los Angeles City Planning staff in conducting four rounds of community meetings throughout the Regional Core. Their role is described as logistical and coordinative, with no position on the project alternatives expressed. Additionally, an SCRTD representative served as chairman of the Interagency Technical Committee's Marketing Sub-Committee for nine of fifteen months.
